subject: K_HARD_MAX 8 D-reported not frozen by A
body:
D-INTEG-01 090254 reports compiled K_HARD_MAX=8 (SPEAR slot ceiling).

A does NOT freeze that integer (not 8, not 16). K_HARD_MAX remains C-owned compiled ceiling; K_HARD remains loaded profile. K_HARD > K_HARD_MAX => fail-closed k_invalid; B maps.

No rematch of 085453 SPEAR Q5.19 24-bit MAC != identity.
No FEM_PERSIST_PASS.
